agent_unreachable.title: Agent {agent_id} does not answer
agent_unreachable.description: Home Assistant asked agent {agent_id} for its status after starting and got no answer. Check on the agent machine: `sudo systemctl status ha-hypervisor-agent` and `sudo ha-hypervisor-agent check`. This message disappears as soon as the agent connects.

agent_outdated.description: The agent runs version {agent_version}, the integration is {version}. Install the newer .deb package on the agent machine and restart the service: `sudo systemctl restart ha-hypervisor-agent`.

create_snapshot.name: Create snapshot
create_snapshot.description: Takes a snapshot of the selected VMs, on vSphere or Proxmox. Refused if the name already exists on one of them.

name.name: Name
name.description: 2 to 40 letters, digits, - and _, starting with a letter.

memory.name: Include memory
memory.description: Also save the memory of running VMs, so a revert returns to a running VM. Slower and larger. Containers always get a disk snapshot.

revert_snapshot.name: Revert to snapshot
revert_snapshot.description: Returns the selected VMs to a snapshot. Their current state is lost. Checked on every VM before any is reverted; vCenter and protected VMs are refused.

start.name: Start afterwards
start.description: Power on VMs that are off after the revert.

delete_snapshot.name: Delete snapshot
delete_snapshot.description: Removes a snapshot from the selected VMs.

start_scenario.name: Start scenario
start_scenario.description: Starts the hosts a scenario needs and its VMs in order.

stop_scenario.name: Stop scenario
stop_scenario.description: Stops the VMs of a scenario in reverse order, keeping VMs used by other active scenarios.
